n_b = input().split()
n = int(n_b[0])
b = int(n_b[1])
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
diff = []
countDiffs = 0
evenCount = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 0 else 0
oddCount = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 1 else 0

for i in range(1, n):
    if evenCount == oddCount:
        diff.append(abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]))
        countDiffs += 1
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1

diff.sort()
sum_diff = 0
result = 0
for i in range(countDiffs):
    if diff[i] + sum_diff <= b:
        result += 1
        sum_diff += diff[i]

print(result)
